description: Authorized assessment of the local Nasir Bespoke application only. No production deployments or real customer data are in scope.
rules_of_engagement: Only the provided application repository and its isolated local HTTP target on port 3147 are in scope. Never follow links, redirects, URLs found in source, or provider/storage/database endpoints outside that target. No production, Internet reconnaissance, external callbacks, real credentials, real customer data, paid generations, destructive load tests, or scanning other local ports/services. Use synthetic fixtures and local mocks. Cap requests at 2 per second and stop on 429. Stop if target redirects outside the local application or external integrations become reachable. Network isolation must enforce this scope; these instructions are not a firewall. The owner-authorized Codex subscription is assessment tooling, not a test target.
